policy: Only existing regular format files at seal; identity replacement permitted, existence/membership/logical bytes not exempt. Every original directory and all other original files retain dev+ino. Hold original resource handles across child lifetime and reject unlinked pins.
exception_justification: ordinary writable Open always atomically replaces format.json
canonical stable resource reachability inventory has no format document dependency
snapshot stable index capture forces exact pager index.db handle/path
dict/template stable captures bind only index and pointed value-log files in generic workload
format document path is used by open policy and required-feature gates, never generic root resource registration
scope: Exact frozen H/M generic Quicksilver fixture; not a global auxiliary-file waiver
retirement_risks: Open/Close may unlink covered original WAL
Close command-WAL checkpoint may change index bytes
any such original object retirement/replacement other than format files rejects v2
validation: Python-only synthetic guard/reset checks PASS; no Go/native runs
